steps.what: Observe usage and note material quantities equipment readings and problems
Keep records of material or equipment usage and problems from field notes
Check completed records and flag urgent equipment problems to supervisor

tasks.design: Configure a mobile usage form in {OPS_SYSTEM} before considering a separate app. Reuse selected job and equipment details while the operator enters measurements and problem descriptions; keep observation, verification and urgent reporting with the operator.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field notes have to be rewritten into a consistent record.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing mobile records software can provide reusable identifiers and simple entry validation.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising an equipment fault and deciding whether it is safe to continue.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a reading conflicts with actual machine behaviour.
tasks.altitude: Less rewriting; equipment judgement and reporting duties stay the same.

reach.task: Identify recurring faults from checked problem records
reach.learn: Which descriptions and readings enable useful maintenance triage

evidence.claim: Syntess Atrium supports on-site work orders and hours/material capture; this supports the native records direction, not the estimated operator saving.
The proposed equipment form and time split are unmeasured design assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is the operator's record task; fault repair and supervisor response are outside it and earn no saving.
The operator produces date, job, equipment identifier, quantity with unit, meter reading and problem text in s1; all observation and initial capture time remains counted there.
The operator enters or confirms these fields in s2; no automatic telemetry or structured discrepancy code is assumed.
Job and equipment master identifiers come from the site's existing planning process, whose capture is unchanged; missing identifiers are entered manually in s2.
Test native mobile forms first; offline failure falls back to the current notes and manual record entry.
Allowance includes ongoing form and identifier corrections; employee consultation and access rules need local confirmation.
unknowns: Existing mobile support, connectivity and actual rewriting time
research_questions: Can operators complete and verify the native form faster without losing problem detail?

already_counted.description: Record entry and corrections remain within s2; final verification and urgent reporting remain within s3

incremental.description: Maintain form choices and resolve identifier changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=45+16+15=76; gross 24 less 1.5 upkeep gives central net 22.5. High requires repeat identifiers and reliable mobile entry; low covers offline work and corrections absorbing that net benefit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check fuel supplies and inspect accessible storage indicators at site
Judge fuel adequacy for planned work and report shortages

tasks.design: Keep the direct site check and adequacy judgement with the operator. A fuel dashboard would first require reliable sensors and a maintained demand plan, so no digital saving is assumed here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Fuel availability is a physical site condition rather than a dependable digital input.
tasks.enabler_now: No new input producer has been established for automation.
tasks.still_hard: Accounting for unusable stock, changing work and inaccessible gauges.
tasks.human_edge: Relating observed supply to actual conditions and planned equipment use.
tasks.altitude: No change to the operator's fuel-check responsibility.

reach.task: Resolve reported fuel shortages before planned equipment work
reach.learn: How delivery timing constrains available supply

evidence.claim: The retained workflow makes no assumption of remote fuel measurement or automated adequacy decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is checking and reporting, excluding fuel ordering and delivery.
The operator produces the observation in s1 and the assessment in s2; no structured fuel level, par level or demand forecast is assumed.
The existing supervisor's planned work is unchanged; no new data capture is transferred to that role.
No new system or ongoing upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Tank indicators, site access and how planned demand is communicated
research_questions: Is any existing reliable fuel feed available without extra operator capture?

incremental.description: No new process or system upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=65+35=100. Both physical checking and judgement remain unchanged; incremental upkeep is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Study instructions plans and diagrams to understand work requirements
Talk to clients and resolve ambiguities in work requirements

tasks.design: Keep reading the issued {DOCS} plans and discussing ambiguities with the client. The operator still needs the complete relevant drawings and site context, so a generated summary does not replace that interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirements combine diagrams, instructions and spoken context.
tasks.enabler_now: Searchable documents may help access, but no separate search baseline has been established.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising conflicts and knowing when a client request needs a supervisor's decision.
tasks.human_edge: Connecting what the client means with site conditions and equipment limits.
tasks.altitude: No change to work interpretation or decision rights.

reach.task: Resolve conflicting instructions before equipment work starts

evidence.claim: Reading plans and resolving contextual ambiguities remain human work in this design.

assumptions: Boundary excludes producing the client's drawings and executing construction work.
Issued documents are unchanged upstream inputs from the project design process; no structured requirements feed is invented.
The operator produces interpretation in s1 and clarifies it in s2; neither step becomes a zero-time input producer.
No new system, recording or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Document control quality and actual frequency of conflicting instructions
research_questions: Is repeated document retrieval a separately measurable burden beyond necessary plan interpretation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=55+45=100. Reading and client discussion retain their time; zero incremental upkeep and zero claimed saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce record rewriting while retaining direct observation and work interpretation.
reach: Give maintenance and site supervisors clearer factual records
role.ambitious_version: Provide dependable equipment information without weakening site judgement.

job.title: Operating Engineers and Other Construction Equipment Operators
